Closed date : 2020-08-10 08:57:50.183 Case Resolved Dear Constituent      The Boston Public Works Construction Inspection Unit (CIU) Inspector has identified that vault on the sidewalk needing attention as the responsibility of Ever source Electric.      Replacing or repairing vaults is not an easy repair.       Ever source has to have the vaults custom made for each separate location.       This takes time.  In addition the construction itself is technical and involved  as well as expensive.
